correctness.rationale: For every n≥1 the two Gram certificates A−M=(t−1)ww* and A+M=2P+2rr*/[n(3n+1)] give a factorization with squared vector norms t. The weighted rank-one input splits into the zero-sum leaf space and the hub/mean-leaf plane, giving the claimed trace norm; the operator lower bound also follows directly from S_M(I−2vv*)x=t x. The mask is identity at n=1. At that size the optional sentence about sign(B) with +1 on the kernel is not literally correct: sign_+(B)=I, but the stated reflection is still a norming unitary. Duality gives the trace-class norm. Finite coordinate corners determine the operator and amplification norms for any leaf set. Existence and normality also follow directly from the limiting Gram kernel: A−M=(2/3)ww*, and A+M=2I on leaf coordinates plus the rank-one kernel (2/3)rr*, with r=(2,1,1,…). The finite corners give the sharp lower bound 5/3. Strict increase follows from the stated exact deficit.
residual_risks: The bounded sample is not the all-size or arbitrary-cardinality proof; those parts were checked algebraically.

Arbitrary cardinality follows immediately from the same uniform finite-compression bound and countable lower bound, so it does not leave a distinct exact invariant. The indexed dates are later than the frozen October 26 record: this is a finding of duplicate mathematical coverage, not a finding that the later entries came first or that the frozen work was derived from them. Levene independently predates both for n=2 only.
residual_risks: Catalogue dates and current equivalent coverage do not determine priority or independent provenance.

value.rationale: A sharp endpoint norm on a star is a meaningful test of branching and of dimension dependence. But against the verified exact family and its immediate finite-corner consequence there is no surviving new precise invariant; the Gram and rank-one identities certify the same optimum and the optional witness is not a distinct extremizer theorem.
residual_risks: This judgment concerns the remaining mathematical contribution after matching coverage, not the historical usefulness of the calculation.
